fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: A weapon strike driven between the plates that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Steel-Shod Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 12 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Angled Plates
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fitted Harness
fusions.desc: Conjures armour that moves with you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your dodge chance rises by 3%, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
